{"path":"neuron_growth_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html","edit_description":"Create a NEW single self-contained HTML file: an animated neon "neuron growth" simulation using one 800x800 canvas, vanilla JS, and dat.gui (the ONLY external library, loaded from CDN). Write the COMPLETE file from scratch following this exact specification. No images, no textures, no other libraries. Do not mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style anywhere in code or comments.

=== HTML/CSS SHELL ===
- <!DOCTYPE html>, <head> with meta charset utf-8, <title>Neural Growth</title>.
- Load dat.gui via: <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js"></script>
- CSS: html,body { margin:0; height:100%; background:#05070f; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden; font-family: monospace; }
- A wrapper div centers the canvas. Canvas: 800x800 (width/height attributes), background #05070f, border:1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.25), box-shadow: 0 0 45px rgba(0,229,255,0.18).
- A small caption line under/over the canvas in color #ffd400, monospace, letter-spacing, subtle text-shadow glow, e.g. "NEURAL GROWTH // SYNAPTIC NETWORK".
- Body contains: wrapper div with <canvas id="c" width="800" height="800"></canvas> and one inline <script> with ALL logic.

=== EXACT NEON PALETTE (defaults) ===
Background #05070f, background glow #101a3a, main branch #00e5ff, accent branch #d6ff00, synapse #ff2bd6, pulse #fff36a, UI accent #ffd400, scanlines rgba(0,229,255,0.08).

=== JS STRUCTURE (use these exact comment section headers) ===
// ===== Setup =====
// ===== GUI setup =====
// ===== Neuron growth =====
// ===== Synapse detection =====
// ===== Pulse animation =====
// ===== Rendering =====
// ===== Main loop =====

=== Setup ===
const canvas, ctx = getContext('2d'), W=H=800.
Params object P with EXACTLY these keys/defaults:
  neuronCount:5, growthSpeed:2.5, maxDepth:6, splitChance:0.35, curvature:0.35, maxLength:110,
  synapseDist:36, synapseGlow:14,
  pulseSpeed:120, pulseFrequency:1.5, pulseBrightness:1.0,
  bgColor:'#05070f', branchColor:'#00e5ff', accentColor:'#d6ff00', synapseColor:'#ff2bd6', pulseColor:'#fff36a'
State (lightweight arrays/objects only):
  neurons=[] ({x,y}), branches=[], tips=[], synapses=[], pulses=[], synKeys=new Set(), branchSeq=0, growing=false, paused=false, MAX_BRANCHES=500.
Each branch: {id, neuronId, depth, points:[{x,y}...], angle, len, maxLen, thick, accent, done}.
Each tip entry: {x,y,branchId,neuronId} (one per branch, mutated as the branch grows).
Each synapse: {ax,ay,bx,by,phase}.
Each pulse: {pts:[{x,y}...], dist, speed, total} where total = precomputed polyline length.
Precompute two offscreen canvases once: (1) scanlineCanvas: 800x800 with horizontal 1px lines every 4px in rgba(0,229,255,0.08); (2) vignette gradient: radial gradient from transparent center to rgba(0,0,0,0.55) at corners, drawn once into an offscreen canvas.
Helper: rand(a,b), samplePolyline(pts,d) returning {x,y} at arc-length d via linear interpolation between points.

=== GUI setup ===
const gui = new dat.GUI();
Folder 'Growth': neuronCount (1..12 step 1), growthSpeed (0.5..8 step 0.1), maxDepth (2..9 step 1), splitChance (0..1 step 0.01), curvature (0..1 step 0.01), maxLength (40..220 step 1).
Folder 'Synapses': synapseDist (10..120 step 1), synapseGlow (0..30 step 1).
Folder 'Pulses': pulseSpeed (20..400 step 5), pulseFrequency (0..6 step 0.1), pulseBrightness (0.2..2 step 0.05).
Folder 'Visuals': addColor for bgColor, branchColor, accentColor, synapseColor, pulseColor.
Open all folders. Root-level buttons via a handler object: 'Regenerate Network' -> regenerate(), 'Clear Canvas' -> clearAll(), 'Pause / Resume' -> toggles paused and updates the button name to 'Resume'/'Pause' via controller.name().

=== Neuron growth ===
regenerate(): reset all state arrays/Set; place P.neuronCount seed neurons near center (400,400): random angle, radius 30..130; each neuron spawns 2-3 initial depth-0 branches at random angles; growing=true.
spawnBranch(x,y,angle,depth,neuronId): maxLen = P.maxLength*(0.6+rand*0.6)*(depth===0?1:0.8); thick = Math.max(0.5,(P.maxDepth-depth)*0.55)*(0.7+rand*0.6); accent = Math.random()<0.18; push branch and its tip entry.
grow(dt) called each frame while growing: for each branch not done, extend in sub-steps of ~2px (n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(P.growthSpeed/2)) sub-steps, step = P.growthSpeed/n): b.angle += (Math.random()-0.5)*P.curvature; new point = tip + (cos,sin)(angle)*step; push to b.points; update the branch's tip entry; b.len += step; after each sub-step run synapse check for this tip (see below). When b.len >= b.maxLen: b.done=true; onBranchComplete(b).
onBranchComplete(b): if branches.length < MAX_BRANCHES and b.depth < P.maxDepth: with probability 0.85 spawn continuation child (angle += (rand-0.5)*0.6, depth+1); with probability P.splitChance spawn a side split child (angle += (rand<0.5?-1:1)*(0.5+rand*0.7), depth+1); additionally with probability 0.12 spawn one smaller side branch from a random midpoint of b.points (depth+1, shorter maxLen via the normal spawnBranch formula). When no branch remains not-done, set growing=false (network stable).

=== Synapse detection ===
On each growth sub-step, compare the moved tip against every other tip with a DIFFERENT neuronId; if euclidean distance < P.synapseDist, call addSynapse(tipA, tipB).
addSynapse: key = Math.min(branchIdA,branchIdB)+'_'+Math.max(branchIdA,branchIdB); if synKeys.has(key) return; else add key and push {ax,ay,bx,by, phase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2} using current tip coordinates (fixed snapshot). This prevents duplicate synapses between the same branch pair.

=== Pulse animation ===
updatePulses(dt): spawn: if pulses.length < 40 and Math.random() < P.pulseFrequency*dt: with 50% chance pick a random synapse -> pulse pts=[{x:ax,y:ay},{x:bx,y:by}]; else pick a random done branch with >=2 points -> pulse travels along its points array. Initialize dist=0, speed=P.pulseSpeed*(0.7+rand*0.6), total=polyline length.
Update each pulse: dist += speed*dt; if dist > total remove it. Position obtained via samplePolyline(pts, dist); also keep previous position for a short spark trail.

=== Rendering ===
render(dt) every frame (even when paused, so colors/GUI changes show):
1. ctx.fillStyle=P.bgColor; fillRect whole canvas.
2. Background glow: radial gradient centered (400,400) from rgba(16,26,58,0.55) to transparent at radius ~560, fillRect.
3. drawImage(scanlineCanvas,0,0). Grit: ~30 random 1px rects in rgba(255,255,255,0.03) at random positions (cheap noise).
4. Branches: for each branch with >=2 points: ctx.strokeStyle = b.accent ? P.accentColor : P.branchColor; ctx.lineWidth=b.thick; ctx.lineCap=ctx.lineJoin='round'; ctx.shadowColor=same as stroke; ctx.shadowBlur=8; smoothed path: moveTo points[0]; for i=1..n-2 quadraticCurveTo(points[i], midpoint(points[i],points[i+1])); lineTo last point; stroke. After loop set ctx.shadowBlur=0.
5. Neuron somas: for each neuron: fillStyle=P.branchColor, shadowColor=P.branchColor, shadowBlur=18, circle radius 6; then a small white core radius 2 with shadowBlur 0.
6. Synapses: for each: s.phase += dt*3; glow = P.synapseGlow*(0.7+0.3*Math.sin(s.phase)); draw a thin line (a)->(b) with strokeStyle=P.synapseColor, globalAlpha 0.5, lineWidth 1.2, shadowColor=P.synapseColor, shadowBlur=glow; then glowing circles radius 2.5+Math.sin(s.phase) at both ends (brighter than branches). Reset globalAlpha and shadowBlur.
7. Pulses: for each: pos=samplePolyline; draw trail line prev->pos strokeStyle=P.pulseColor globalAlpha 0.6*P.pulseBrightness lineWidth 1.5; then spark: fillStyle=P.pulseColor, shadowColor=P.pulseColor, shadowBlur=16*P.pulseBrightness, globalAlpha=Math.min(1,P.pulseBrightness), circle radius 2.2; plus tiny white core radius 1. Reset alpha/shadow.
8. drawImage(vignetteCanvas,0,0).
9. HUD: bottom-left, 10px monospace, fillStyle 'rgba(255,212,0,0.75)' (#ffd400 at 0.75 alpha), text like 'BRANCHES 123  SYNAPSES 45  PULSES 6' plus 'GROWING' or 'STABLE' state.

=== Main loop ===
let last=performance.now(); function frame(now){ const dt=Math.min(0.05,(now-last)/1000); last=now; if(!paused){ if(growing) grow(dt); updatePulses(dt);} render(paused?0:dt); requestAnimationFrame(frame);} Call regenerate() once, then requestAnimationFrame(frame).
clearAll(): empty all arrays and synKeys, growing=false (loop keeps rendering the empty background).

Keep the whole file compact, clean, commented per section, and fully working when opened directly in a browser. Ensure all dat.gui controls are live (rendering reads P every frame; growth parameters apply to newly grown branches; regenerate applies neuronCount)."}
